decision.explanation: Different documents mention different dates and contexts for the formation of the National Indian Association. Document d01 states it was formed on January 1, 1900, as a nationalist organization. Documents d02 and d03 mention a 1870 formation by Mary Carpenter in Bristol focused on social progress in India. Document d04 refers to a 1879 formation related to American Indian rights. These refer to distinct organizations sharing similar names but differing in purpose and location.
